How is SCRIPE-Frontend architected for strict 5-layer SOLID MVVM and sub-module isolation?

Long image

A

Answer

SCRIPE-Frontend runs a Next.js 16 + React 19 portal where 65+ sub-modules follow a strict 5-layer SOLID MVVM pipeline with Inversify DI and TanStack Query v5.1

  1. Every feature resides in an isolated sub-module (src/modules/{workspace}/{sub-module}/) containing domain/, data/, presentation/, and co-located locales/.2
  2. Presentation Views and ViewModels never import IApiService or wire DTOs; all traffic flows through View -> ViewModel -> Repository -> Service -> IApiService.3
  3. ApiService automatically attaches X-Tenant-Id and X-Idempotency-Key headers and queues concurrent 401 responses behind a single refresh request.4
  4. useCrudViewModel and GenericCrudView standardize pagination (<= 100), debounced search, and optimistic TanStack Query mutations across master-data modules.5

Applies toNext.js 16React 19 Compiler65+ Sub-Modules5-Layer MVVMTanStack Query v5 + Zustand

How do the 5 MVVM layers, providers, and state stores connect across a feature sub-module?

Diagram structure
  • Next.js Edge Proxy edge_proxy
  • RouteGuard & PBAC route_guard
  • I18n & Nexus Theme i18n_provider
  • @core/ui System core_ui
  • 1. Feature View feature_view
  • Generic CRUD Engine crud_engine
  • 2. ViewModel Hook viewmodel_hook
  • TanStack & Zustand query_zustand
  • 3. Domain Repository domain_repo
  • 4. Data Service data_service
  • 5. ApiService Adapter api_service
  • SignalRProvider signalr_hub
  • SCRIPE-Backend API backend_api
  • edge_proxy → route_guard · cookie ok
  • route_guard → feature_view · PBAC ok
  • i18n_provider → route_guard · t() + dir
  • core_ui → crud_engine · @core/ui
  • crud_engine → viewmodel_hook · useCrudVM
  • feature_view → viewmodel_hook · 1 -> 2 hook
  • viewmodel_hook → query_zustand · TanStack
  • viewmodel_hook → domain_repo · 2 -> 3 repo
  • domain_repo → data_service · 3 -> 4 DTO
  • data_service → api_service · 4 -> 5 API
  • api_service → backend_api · HTTPS + Idem
  • backend_api → signalr_hub · WS push
  • signalr_hub → query_zustand · invalidate
  1. Edge & RouteGuard ↗

    src/proxy.ts verifies session cookies at the edge; RouteGuard enforces PAGE_PERMISSIONS and Edition feature entitlements.

  2. 1. Feature View ↗

    Declarative React 19 UI built exclusively from @core/ui primitives, Nexus tokens, and t("...") locale keys.

  3. 2. ViewModel Hook ↗

    useBookingWorkspaceViewModel or useCrudViewModel manages local UI state and TanStack Query caches without touching HTTP.

  4. 3. Domain Repository ↗

    BookingRepository translates backend wire DTOs into clean frontend Domain Entities (Booking).

  5. 4. Data Service ↗

    BookingService encapsulates versioned endpoint paths and delegates network calls to the injected IApiService.

  6. 5. ApiService Adapter ↗

    Attaches JWT, tenant, and idempotency headers, unwraps Result<T>, and coordinates single-flight 401 refreshes.

2

How does ApiService prevent 401 refresh storms during concurrent mutations?

Diagram structure
  • BookingWorkspaceView view
  • useBookingWorkspaceVM vm
  • BookingRepo + Service repo
  • ApiService (401 Mutex) api
  • SCRIPE-Backend API srv
  • view → vm · handleConfirmBooking(formValues)
  • vm → repo · repository.create(payload) -> service.post()
  • repo → api · apiService.post('/api/v1/venue/reservations')
  • api → srv · POST (Expired 15m JWT + X-Idempotency-Key)
  • srv → api · 401 Unauthorized
  • api → srv · Lock isRefreshing=true -> POST /api/v1/auth/refresh
  • srv → api · New 15m Access JWT + Rotated Cookie
  • api → srv · Drain failedQueue -> Replay POST (Same IdempotencyKey)
  • srv → api · 200 OK Result<ReservationDto>
  • api → repo · Unwrap Result<T> Data
  • repo → vm · Map to Booking Domain Entity
  • vm → view · Invalidate TanStack Query + Toast Success

Why is DTO-to-Entity mapping inside the Repository non-negotiable?

Mapping DTOs inside BookingRepository ensures backend property renames or SecureId adjustments never leak into React components.3

When should a sub-module use GenericCrudView vs a Custom Domain Workspace?

Architectural AxisGeneric CRUD Engine (useCrudViewModel)Custom Domain Workspace (useWorkspaceViewModel)
Primary Use CaseRapid scaffoldingMaster-data tables, lookups, roles, pipeline configsMulti-pane resource calendars, pitch tactical boards, kanban pipelines
State & Query HookuseCrudViewModel(repository, options) with built-in debounce & paginationCustom ViewModel hook composing useGenericQuery & useGenericMutations
UI SurfaceGenericCrudView composing @core/ui/table, dialog, button, badgeCustom views built 100% from @core/ui and Nexus CSS surface tokens
Real-Time SyncAutomatic query invalidation on create/update/deleteOptimistic slot holds + live SignalRProvider event subscriptions
